[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 7: Point of Interest and Safe Zone Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]7.1[/color] Point of Interest (PoI) structures must not be disabled, destroyed, or rendered inoperable unless authorized by higher command or required for a specific approved purpose. ★
[color=#a4885c]7.2[/color] Point of Interest locations must remain dedicated to their intended function unless higher command explicitly authorizes an alternative use. (Example: Establishing a temporary medical treatment area in Bahama Mama's during an emergency is permitted, but converting Edison Powerplant into a data center by using its infrastructure without approval is prohibited.) ★
[color=#a4885c]7.3[/color] Central Command (CC) and Medical Department (MD) are designated as Safe Zones.
[color=#a4885c]7.3A[/color] Acts of uncivilized conduct within a Safe Zone—including murder, assault, theft, sabotage, or malicious damage to another player's ship or property—will be handled in-character by Security and may also result in out-of-character administrative action for serious violations. ★★
[color=#a4885c]7.3B[/color] A radius of 512 meters surrounding a designated Safe Zone structure is considered part of the Safe Zone.
[color=#a4885c]7.4[/color] Point of Interest locations that are not designated Safe Zones, such as Edison Powerplant, Drillsite, and similar facilities, must not be intentionally damaged except during authorized circumstances such as faction conflicts, administrative events, or other approved scenarios. ★
